title: Bloomreach Discovery - AI-driven product discovery and recommendations
clean_text: Bloomreach Discovery is an AI-driven commerce experience platform combining personalized site search, merchandising, and product recommendations. It uses Loomi, Bloomreach's proprietary AI, to power frequently-bought-together and personalized recommendation models alongside search relevance tuning. The platform is split into separately priced modules: Site Search, Merchandising, Recommendations, and SEO. Integrates with Shopify, BigCommerce, and custom storefronts via API. Bloomreach also offers a separate Engagement product for email and marketing automation, and Content for headless CMS. Targets mid-to-large enterprise retailers requiring unified search and personalization.
